scratch.notes: Every lever available: the architecture, the tokenizer and the data are all choices the compiler gets to make.

pretrain.note: expensive, but the only way to put knowledge in the weights from nothing

open_weight.notes: The architecture and tokenizer are frozen. Everything the compiler achieves here it achieves through data, adapters, grafted circuits and steering.

choose_architecture.note: the architecture was fixed by whoever trained these weights and cannot be changed without discarding them

choose_tokenizer.note: the tokenizer is baked into the embedding matrix

pretrain.note: pretraining from nothing would throw away the weights that make this substrate worth using

continued_pretrain.note: extends what the model knows without discarding it

adapter.note: cheap, composable, leaves the base weights intact

knowledge.rationale: the material is in the weights from the start, which is only possible when we are the ones training the model
extends what a downloaded model knows without discarding what it already knows
cheap and reversible; the base weights are untouched
the material stays outside the weights and is fetched on demand

skill.rationale: the skill exists as a verified circuit and can be written into the weights directly, with no training at all
teach it as one skill among several while the model trains
show the model examples of the skill

style.rationale: style is a direction in activation space; steering it is a runtime write with a measured dose, and costs no training
bake the style into the weights when steering is not available or not sufficient

invariant.rationale: watch the internal signal for the property and push it when it slips, with a bounded side-effect
train the behaviour in when it cannot be watched

prohibition.rationale: the topic is a direction; suppressing it is a runtime write, bounded by a side-effect budget so it cannot lobotomize the model
last resort: block at the output when the internal direction cannot be isolated

guardrail.rationale: refusal is a measured, dose-responsive direction; amplifying it hardens the model without retraining
